bookings_plan.definition: Synthetic demonstration definition: executed contract consideration newly booked during the period; excludes cancellations, taxes, and unexercised options. Not recognized revenue.

recognized_plan.definition: Synthetic demonstration definition: revenue recognized for satisfied performance obligations during the accounting period, net of reversals.
